question_pattern: What [field] did IBM Quantum job d5a6s6jht8fs73a5d46g [have/run as]?
root_cause: BM25 ranking places a short provenance record (503: 672 chars, JID at char 52) above the gold job record (38202: 2366 chars, JID at char 26). The short record's JID appears in a structured field near the start, giving it higher BM25 term density for the query terms 'IBM Quantum job [jid]'. The gold record has the JID at char 26 followed immediately by 'on backend ibm_fez', but its 2354-token OPENQASM circuit body dilutes the term density after the first 50 tokens. Ranker cannot distinguish: a provenance stub (public, train split) from an unrelated project vs. the actual job record (sensitive, val split).
notes: All 5 items for JID d5a6s6jht8fs73a5d46g fail. The model abstained correctly for 4/5 (v045-v048) when given the wrong context. This is a retrieval problem, not a synthesis problem.
